test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A # B means ‘A is the sister of B’.

A @ B means ‘A is the son of B’.

A & B means ‘A is the father of B’.

A % B means ‘A is the mother of B’.

If W @ Q # T & Y @ M % K, then how is Q related to K?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] Given : A is Symbol # @ & % Meaning Sister Son Father Mother to B Statement : **W @ Q # T & Y @ M % K** So, according to the given symbols :​ • W @ Q → W is the son of Q. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbaa5aaf6f7f2a2a3c1faddee8c3a37248cfe3a82c6eef7660fbf71bef8b6a92.png] ​ • Q # T → Q is the sister of T. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/691d00311da005f9617a2cb55eb581f530ac2c5854e896d757c029138ffd8275.png] ​ • T & Y → T is the father of Y. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3116ea439ee23109771ca907c18d47c296cf8a172d4cfcdcd31a223ce731334.png] ​ • Y @ M → Y is the son of M. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a14c5cc64192918d4599aa2b3553e5e5fc3118e5d1c6213776ba134fa3d29101.png] ​ • M % K → M is the mother of K. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43c607c946797490efb85806f363abfa65fd2e41118dde38969c7ba563b18d2b.png] ​​​​​ Thus, according to the final family tree Q is the paternal aunt or father's sister of K. Hence, "**Father’s sister**" is the correct answer. 67:T12b1,
